task_description: Implement the Bholix Flutter app core schema engine (Blogger JSON-LD fetch/parse/resolve/merge), data layer (location, cart, wishlist, search), feature BLoCs (grid, product, cart, location), full UI scaffolding (GridPage, ProductPage, CartSheet, LocationPicker, SearchBar), and wire routing — all grounded in kaisel sealed-route + CubitSignal patterns already in the project.
